status: preregistered before feature extraction and pilot fitting
scope: development-only, assistant-authored labels; no default promotion
frozen_layers: encoder, projection, history, attention, mix and all non-body task heads
trainable: body linear head, conditional strength linear head, separate 3-class necessity MLP

splits.final_test: not created; previous final test never loaded

independent_unit: whole story family; all context contrasts and history variants stay together
arms_faces_appearance: not fitted or changed in this study

experiments.preferred: single preferred-label cross entropy plus conditional strength midpoint regression
experiments.acceptable: negative log probability of acceptable set plus 0.25 preferred-label CE and conditional interval strength loss
experiments.necessity: same type and strength prediction as acceptable, plus independent 128-64-3 necessity head CE; reject forbidden or restore required active proposal at inference

selection: no hyperparameter search. Fixed 1000 steps. Report all seeds; do not pick best seed
calibration: fit necessity temperature by NLL only on calibration, then use same fixed threshold grid for all probe families; prior old-model threshold remains 0.4
calibration_objective: 0.5 * required acceptable recall + 0.5 * forbidden specificity, minus 0.1 * optional unacceptable fraction; ties favor required recall then higher active threshold
report: necessity NLL and Brier before and after calibration
inference_scope: clause-level proposals only; busy/cooldown/execution eligibility and visual naturalness require separate runtime checks
limitations: Small draft corpus and developer-selected policy. No OOD risk guarantee or human naturalness conclusion; fresh independent final scenes required after annotation review.
